title: The First Year
logline: Two broken cats and a lonely human learn to be a family.
main_arc: Mango learns performance isn't love. Shadow learns vulnerability isn't weakness.
finale_hook: A voicemail arrives. Someone is looking for Mango.

title: The Return
logline: Mango's past comes back to the door.
main_arc: Mango's past returns and tests the new family.
finale_hook: The Human gets a job abroad.

title: The Departure
main_arc: The family weighs staying put against a bigger life.
finale_hook: A new kitten arrives at the shelter.

title: The New Arrival
logline: Mango and Shadow mentor a frightened kitten.
main_arc: Mentorship; the old wounds teach the new arrival.
finale_hook: The kitten mentions a lost sibling.

title: The Search
logline: Shadow's past catches up with the family.
main_arc: Shadow confronts where he came from.
finale_hook: Flash forward: an older Mango, alone.
